column1: # .dsh/policy/memorisation.tsv — the memorisation check's thresholds and exemptions (spec 2026-09-25 §3).
# Two row shapes, TAB-separated; blank and #-led lines are ignored.
#   key TAB value                  a threshold: min_overlap (default 8), min_ratio (0.5), trivial_abs (10)
#   path TAB construct TAB reason  an exemption for one construct, construct = kind:name:line
# A construct is flagged when at least min_overlap of its non-trivial literals also appear in the
# visible tests AND they make up at least min_ratio of its literals. An exemption is for a table whose
# keys legitimately coincide with test values — say why in the reason.
